title: 第一卷 第30章 水猴子
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
夜深，津门码头。

    江风带着腥气，往人领口里灌。

    没有月亮，只有几盏昏黄的气死风灯，在风里摇曳，把人的影子拉得像鬼一样长。

    漕运商会总部的后墙，高约两丈，上面插着碎玻璃碴子。

    墙根底下，蹲着一排黑影。

    赵海柱摸了摸腰间的盒子炮，压低声音：“川子，真要这么干？”

    陆川靠在墙根，手里把玩着一把匕首。

    匕首不长，但刃口泛着蓝光，那是淬了毒的。

    “沈玉楼那老东西，今晚肯定在商会里。”

    陆川的声音很轻，像风刮过砂纸，“他不死，海河帮睡不踏实。”

    赵海柱叹了口气，他知道陆川说的是实话。

    今晚这一票，是奔着杀人去的。

    “行，听你的。”

    赵海柱一挥手，身后的十几个海河帮好手立刻散开。

    这些人都是赵海柱的心腹，手里都有家伙。

    “不过，去找沈玉楼，先去一趟库房。”

    赵海柱忽然改了主意。

    “库房？”

    陆川挑眉。

    “对。”

    赵海柱眼里闪过一丝精光，“最近漕运商会走货神秘得很，连咱们海河帮的探子都摸不清底细。”

    “要是能搞清楚他们运的是什么，以后津门的生意，咱们就能掐住他们的七寸。”

    陆川想了想，点头。

    “有道理。”

    “杀人随时都能杀，但这情报，确实重要。”

    “谁去？”

    话音刚落，旁边蹲着的一个矮小汉子凑了过来。

    这人瘦得像根麻杆，眼珠子乱转，一看就是个机灵鬼。

    “帮主，陆哥，我去。”

    汉子拍了拍胸脯，“这津门地界，还没有我刘三手进不去的门。”

    刘三手，早年是津门街头有名的扒手。

    一手缩骨功练得登峰造极，据说能钻进酒坛子里偷酒喝。

    后来偷到了赵海柱头上，被暴揍一顿后，收编进了海河帮。

    赵海柱看了他一眼，“库房那边守备森严，全是洋枪队，你能行？”

    “瞧好吧您嘞！”

    刘三手嘿嘿一笑，身子一缩，整个人竟然像没骨头一样，往地上一趴，薄得像张纸。

    “只要有个缝，我就能钻。”

    赵海柱点头：“行，半个时辰。不管拿到什么，半个时辰内必须出来。”

    “要是动静大了，我们就直接强攻。”

    “得令！”

    刘三手一溜烟窜了出去。

    他像只壁虎，贴着墙根摸到了库房的通气窗下。

    那窗户只有巴掌大，还装着铁栏杆。

    刘三手深吸一口气，胸腔猛地一缩，肋骨竟然发出咔咔的轻响，整个人硬生生小了一圈。

    嗖！

    像条泥鳅，钻进去了。

    ......

    库房里很黑。

    空气中弥漫着一股怪味。

    不是货物的霉味，也不是药味。

    是一种类似于臭咸鱼混合着福尔马林的味道。

    刘三手落地无声。

    他贴着墙根，慢慢往里摸。

    眼睛适应了黑暗后，他看清了里面的景象。

    这一看，他头皮都炸了。

    库房很大，足有半个足球场那么大。

    但里面没有箱子，没有麻袋。

    只有一排排巨大的木笼。

    笼子上盖着黑布。

    角落里，还停着几口黑漆漆的棺材。

    “这帮孙子，运尸体？”

    刘三手心里嘀咕。

    漕运商会明面上是走盐走粮的，怎么改行运棺材了？

    他壮着胆子，摸到一个木笼前。

    笼子里有动静。

    细微的，压抑的呼吸声。

    还有......哭声？

    刘三手咽了口唾沫，手有点抖。

    他轻轻掀开黑布的一角。

    借着通气窗透进来的微光，他看清了。

    笼子里关着人。

    有女人，有孩子，还有青壮年的汉子。

    他们衣衫褴褛，眼神空洞，脖子上都带着铁项圈，像牲口一样挤在一起。

    “人口买卖......”

    刘三手倒吸一口凉气。

    这漕运商会，表面光鲜亮丽，背地里竟然干着这种断子绝孙的勾当！
content_en:
Late at night, Jinmen Pier.

    Jiang Feng filled people's collars with a fishy smell.

    There was no moon, only a few dim yellow wind lanterns swaying in the wind, stretching people's shadows as long as ghosts.

    The back wall of the headquarters of the Water Transport Chamber of Commerce is about two feet high, with broken glass particles stuck on it.

    Under the wall, a row of black figures squatted.

    Zhao Haizhu touched the box cannon on his waist and lowered his voice: "Kawako, do you really want to do this?"

    Lu Chuan leaned against the wall, playing with a dagger in his hand.

    The dagger is not long, but the edge glows with blue light, which is quenched with poison.

    "That old guy Shen Yulou must be at the Chamber of Commerce tonight."

    Lu Chuan's voice was very soft, like wind blowing through sandpaper, "Unless he dies, the Haihe Gang will not be able to sleep peacefully."

    Zhao Haizhu sighed, he knew that Lu Chuan was telling the truth.

    This vote tonight is for killing people.

    "Okay, it's up to you."

    Zhao Haizhu waved his hand, and the dozen Haihe helpers behind him immediately dispersed.

    These people are all Zhao Haizhu's confidants, and they all have guys in their hands.

    "However, to find Shen Yulou, first go to the warehouse."

    Zhao Haizhu suddenly changed his mind.

    "Warehouse?"

    Lu Chuan raised his eyebrows.

    "Yes."

    A glint flashed in Zhao Haizhu's eyes, "The cargo shipped by the Water Transport Chamber of Commerce has been very mysterious recently, and even our Haihe Gang spies can't figure out the details."

    "If we can figure out what they are transporting, we can control their business in Jinmen in the future."

    Lu Chuan thought for a while and nodded.

    "That makes sense."

    "You can kill at any time, but this information is really important."

    "Who's going?"

    As soon as he finished speaking, a short man squatting next to him came over.

    This man was as thin as a stick, his eyes were moving around, and he looked like a clever guy at first glance.

    "Gang leader, Brother Lu, I'll go."

    The man patted his chest and said, "There is no door in Jinmen that I, Liu Sanshou, cannot enter."

    Liu Sanshou was a famous pickpocket on the streets of Jinmen in his early years.

    He has mastered the bone-shrinking skill to such perfection that he is said to be able to sneak into wine jars and steal wine.

    Later, he stole Zhao Haizhu's head, and after being beaten violently, he was incorporated into the Haihe Gang.

    Zhao Haizhu glanced at him and said, "The warehouse is heavily guarded and full of foreign gunmen. Can you do it?"

    "Look at you!"

    Liu Sanshou chuckled, shrank his body, and lay down on the ground as if he had no bones, as thin as a piece of paper.

    "As long as there is a gap, I can drill it."

    Zhao Haizhu nodded: "Okay, half an hour. No matter what you get, you must come out within half an hour."

    "If the movement becomes too big, we will attack directly."

    "Got the order!"

    Liu Sanshou fled out in a flash.

    Like a gecko, he pressed against the wall and reached under the ventilation window of the warehouse.

    The window was only as big as a hand and had iron bars.

    Liu Sanshou took a deep breath, his chest shrank suddenly, his ribs made a soft cracking sound, and his whole body suddenly shrunk.

    Whoosh!

    Like a loach, it got in.

    ...

    It was dark in the warehouse.

    There was a strange smell in the air.

    It's not the musty smell of goods, nor is it the smell of medicine.

    It has a smell similar to smelly salted fish mixed with formalin.

    Liu San's hands fell to the ground silently.

    He pressed against the wall and slowly touched inside.

    After his eyes adjusted to the darkness, he saw the scene inside clearly.

    At this sight, his scalp exploded.

    The warehouse is huge, as big as half a football field.

    But there were no boxes or sacks inside.

    Just rows of huge wooden cages.

    The cage was covered with black cloth.

    In the corner, there were several dark coffins parked.

    "These grandsons are transporting corpses?"

    Liu Sanshou muttered in his heart.

    The Water Transport Chamber of Commerce is apparently transporting salt and grain, so why has it changed its business to transporting coffins?

    He took courage and walked to a wooden cage.

    There was movement in the cage.

    Small, muffled breathing.

    And...crying?

    Liu Sanshou swallowed, his hands shaking a little.

    He gently lifted a corner of the black cloth.

    He could see clearly through the dim light coming from the ventilation window.

    There are people in cages.

    There were women, children, and young and middle-aged men.

    They were dressed in rags, had empty eyes, and wore iron collars around their necks. They were crowded together like animals.

    "Human trafficking..."

    Liu Sanshou took a breath of cold air.

    This Water Transport Chamber of Commerce looks glamorous on the outside, but behind the scenes they are doing this kind of thing that will end their descendants!
